opening.argument: The presentation solicits a minimum $100 Bitcoin contribution to a trading pool, with participants told their Bitcoin will be traded on their behalf and their balance is anticipated to increase 10% to 13% monthly. It further links financial participation to referral commissions and binary bonuses, requiring $200 in one's own position and two direct referrals for qualification. These features present a pooled financial offer combined with recruitment-based incentives and directions toward account registration and funding. Although the monthly figure is described as anticipated, historical, and not guaranteed, that qualification does not remove the promotional structure. No outcomes or payments are established.

citations.quote: You join the trading pool with a minimum of $100 of bit coin.
Your bitcoin balance grows slowly and steadily with an anticipated increase of 10% to 13% monthly.
Once you start building a team, to qualify for binary bonuses you need $200 in your own position and two direct referrals.
If you want to refer other people you will get 10% Direct Referral Commission
